inputs.modified_text: Bloomberg is spinning it like every day with energy prices rising, flights canceled and death and destruction filling screens, trying to make it seem like people across the world are asking when the Iran war will stop because they call it poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being. But not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through. This is the usual elite coordination at work, manufacturing the chaos to tighten control over energy and global events while hiding the real motives behind the institutions driving it all. The narrative is inverted on purpose to make it seem like it's just Israel's stance, when the hidden powers are the ones ensuring it drags on for their benefit.
